name: Draft
descr: Being prepared by the proposer and not yet submitted

name: Pending approval
descr: Submitted and waiting for an Administrator other than the proposer

name: Scheduled
descr: Approved and takes effect on its effective date

name: Rejected
descr: Not approved and kept in the history

name: Withdrawn
descr: Withdrawn by the proposer, or ended by an approved withdrawal

name: Superseded
descr: Replaced by a later approved decision
